name: What should I prepare before contacting a bathroom remodeling contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a bathroom remodeling contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before reaching out to remodeling contractors, establish your total budget, collect inspiration photos, and list non-negotiable functional requirements. Measure your general room dimensions and check where your main water shutoff valve is located. Decide whether you are willing to keep the existing layout or want to relocate plumbing, as this drastically affects estimates. Having clarity on your fixture finishes, storage needs, and preferred timeline allows contractors to provide far more accurate, detailed proposals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Define your budget range, gather design photos, list essential storage or fixture needs, and decide whether you want to change the existing plumbing layout.
